name: Chocolate Cream
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)
steps: Mix corn-starch, sugar, and salt, dilute with cold milk, add to scalded milk, and cook over hot water ten minutes, stirring constantly until thickened; melt chocolate, add hot water, stir until smooth, and add to cooked mixture; add whites of eggs beaten stiff, and vanilla.
Mould, chill, and serve with cream.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
